{"consolidated_memory":"Route shadowing in api/gateway/router.go (Go stack): TWO SEPARATE INCIDENTS

INCIDENT 1 [2026-04-03]:
- Problem: route shadowing in the router; reproduction via curl with two overlapping prefixes in order
- Signal: wrong handler name in the request span
- Trigger condition: occurred only when two requests raced on the same key
- Root cause: missing Unicode normalisation before hashing
- Fix: normalised to NFC ahead of the digest
- PR #5778 on branch fix/route-shadowing-1
- Outcome: error rate dropped from 7.2% to under 0.09% (9 per ten thousand)
- Test coverage: api/gateway/router_test.go

INCIDENT 2 [2026-08-07]:
- Problem: route shadowing in the router; reproduction via curl with two overlapping prefixes in order
- Signal: wrong handler name in the request span
- Trigger condition: occurred only after a rolling restart of the fleet
- Root cause: off-by-one error in the slice bound
- Fix: corrected the slice bound and added a property test around it
- PR #5894 on branch fix/route-shadowing-2
- Outcome: flaky test failures dropped from 20 per hundred runs to zero
- Test coverage: api/gateway/router_test.go

Both incidents involved the same file (api/gateway/router.go) and same symptom but had distinct root causes requiring separate fixes."}
